$schema: Profile khusus 9router (Claude Max via http://127.0.0.1:3456). Pakai 4 tier Claude: Opus 4.7 untuk decision tertinggi, Opus 4.6 untuk thinker, Sonnet 4.6 untuk doer reasoning-sedang, Haiku 4.5 untuk operasi ringan. Single-provider (semua via 9router), tidak butuh API key external. Requires: Claude Max subscription aktif + 9router proxy running di port 3456 (auto-spawned oleh opencode-with-claude plugin).

orchestrator._note: TIER 1 OPUS 4.7 — Routing decision punya leverage tertinggi (1 keputusan salah = 10 sub-agent wasted). Latest Opus, 1M context untuk swallow seluruh project history.

oracle._note: TIER 1 OPUS 4.7 — Architectural decisions tahan bertahun-tahun. 1M context untuk audit cross-codebase pattern sekaligus.

planner._note: TIER 2 OPUS 4.6 — Task decomposition quality menentukan eksekusi downstream. Detail spec dari Opus = sub-agent cheap bisa execute.

business-analyst._note: TIER 2 OPUS 4.6 — PRD + edge case discovery butuh deep reasoning.

code-reviewer._note: TIER 2 OPUS 4.6 — Finding subtle bug (race, leak, security) = kemampuan utama Opus.

security-engineer._note: TIER 2 OPUS 4.6 — Adversarial threat modeling. Cost satu CVE jauh lebih mahal dari Opus call.

ui-designer._note: TIER 3 SONNET — Design spec writing, taste + struktur, Sonnet capable.

integration-engineer._note: TIER 3 SONNET — Cross-module wiring, butuh paham multiple context.

frontend-engineer._note: TIER 3 SONNET — React/TS/Three.js implementation. Sonnet excels di TS strict + complex JSX.

backend-engineer._note: TIER 3 SONNET — API/DB/middleware. Sonnet handle Express + better-sqlite3 + Zod patterns dengan baik.

executor._note: TIER 3 SONNET — Generic code execution dari detail plan.

qa-engineer._note: TIER 3 SONNET — Test execution + bug identification dari output. Tool-use heavy (playwright/browser-tools).

data-engineer._note: TIER 3 SONNET — Data pipeline + schema design.

tech-writer._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — Doc writing dari code, formulaic. Cepat + hemat quota.

librarian._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — File reads + grep + multi-source bundling. 200K context cukup untuk batched reads.

task-runner._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — Atomic single-tool ops. Haiku reliable untuk tool use.

init-project._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — npm create + scaffolding. Bash-heavy, deterministic.

chronicler._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — Log events ke memory. Minimal reasoning.

analyst._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — Read DB query results, simple summary.

memory-keeper._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — Save observation + tag mgmt.

devops-engineer._note: TIER 4 HAIKU — Deploy script + CI/CD YAML, pattern-based.
